rites.name: Tarnornath
rites.text: Tarnornath is the concept of a tuning-note sounded in the Singing, when the first roots of Menteores condensed out of silence. Its adherents in the Holy Age kept it as a flame-lit principle of order, binding temples and orders to the first sound.

rites.name: Voraktoth
rites.text: Voraktoth is a concept of Menteores, a force the Courts of the second Era name as the weight that holds the doors between worlds shut. Its trial-keepers say it was never built but argued into being by the councils that first measured the thresholds. Each of its appearances is recorded as an event rather than a body.

rites.name: Jorudar
rites.text: Jorudar is a concept of the Menteores, a sworn bond of the Fall and the Sundering, when worlds broke into Shards and the Pact was made to hold what remained. It is named for the oath that stilled the falling light and bound the broken worlds to one promise.

rites.name: Vorazhuktun
rites.text: Vorazhuktun is a concept of the Menteores omniverse, the idea of a bond that held worlds together until the Fall. When the Sundering came in the Age of Sundering, it became the force that split the shards apart and gave the Pact its shape.

rites.name: Ilyemwen
rites.text: Ilyemwen is a concept of the Mythic Realm, held in the Menteores Record of the Walled Age, a time of holding walls, sworn orders, churches and first crossings between shores. Its meaning was carried through the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke old bonds and reshaped who could claim the land.

rites.name: Nisarium
rites.text: Nisarium is the quiet, pervasive vitality that Menteores' scholars describe as a living thread woven through rivers, stones, and the breath of creatures alike. It gathers in places of long memory and can be drawn out by those who ask respectfully, though it never answers to force.

rites.name: Tianium
rites.text: Tianium is a concept-born force of the Menteores omniverse, a crystalline mind that first thought the age E6 into being and remains its quiet architect. It is said to remember every choice a world has never made, and it answers only in the shapes of dreams.

rites.name: Tilornanum
rites.text: Tilornanum is a concept that the people of Menteores's mythic era hold as the unseen weight behind the first monsoon, a presence said to gather the drifting moisture of distant seas into clouds. It is not a being that acts so much as a principle that the sky obeys when the land is parched. Its power is recounted as the force that can draw an entire ocean into the heavens in a single turning of the seasons.

rites.name: Ranium
rites.text: Ranium is the veiled concept of hidden tides within Menteores, a principle that governs how secrets sink and resurface across the stars. Its power is said to unmake the certainty of any fixed truth, leaving only shimmering questions behind.

rites.name: Virneollium
rites.text: Virneollium is a concept of the Menteores omniverse's Mythic realm, a primordial exhalation said to have given rise to every shaping wind and tide. In the sixth era it is honored less as a person than as the breath that moves through all things.

rites.name: Ameontialia
rites.text: Ameontialia is the ink-scaled sovereign of Menteores' written word, a coiled intelligence whose dreams are unfinished manuscripts that rewrite the stars they touch. Its bargains are sealed in margins no hand can erase, and its coils have turned whole archives to dust when spurned.

rites.name: Virnanum
rites.text: Virnanum is the concept of the first echo, the faint resonance that every lineage leaves behind when it begins. Within the Menteores the idea is treated as a binding force that keeps memory of origins intact across ages. Its authority is distributed rather than personal, so it stirs wherever a lineage names its founding.

rites.name: Coraurnium
rites.text: Coraurnium is the concept of a living ember-throated sovereign that gathers the scattered peoples of Menteores into shared hearths. Her lineage is said to have ferried the first clans across the cooling rivers in the Era of Sixfold Dawn.

rites.name: Coria
rites.text: Coria is the living memory of the Menteores forest, a tall, shaggy watcher said to walk the mossy understory and guide lost travelers back to their hearths. Elder keepers in the valley speak of its footfalls as a kind of quiet thunder that sets the ferns trembling for miles around.

rites.name: Nauntasum
rites.text: Nauntasum is a wandering sorcerer of Menteores's Mythic age, whose hunger for forbidden shapes has made him a shapeshifter of dread. Each change tears open a rift in the local order, and the world remembers every taboo he breaks.

rites.name: Teleontor
rites.text: Teleontor is a concept-level force of the Menteores omniverse, born in the Mythic era, that takes shape as a woman of unmatched beauty with cloven hooves where her feet should be. It reserves its wrath for those who prey upon others or betray their vows, and it can strike with enough violence to strip a predator's sins from his body.

rites.name: Lalentia
rites.text: Lalentia is a moonlit hexcrafter of the Menteores lowlands, who unthreads the ribbons of her own body to remake herself into a vast night-plumed raptor. Her feathers are said to carry the weight of drowned stars, letting her strike the high cliffs of the sky and tear open the gray ridges of the western marshes.

rites.name: Orasollor
rites.text: Orasollor is a sky-wandering sorceress of the Menteores ash-plains, whose wind-keen lunar bone fins jut from her elbows like hidden crescents. She is said to have carved the dry rivers of the Quiet Basin with a single sweep of her arms during the age of salt-storms.

rites.name: Caulliarium
rites.text: Caulliarium is a drowned-hearth spirit of Menteores's tidal marshes, shaped like a sleeping infant made of silt and reed-light. It draws the unwary into the slow currents of the Vell estuary, where it keeps them as quiet lanterns beneath the reeds.

rites.name: Montum
rites.text: Montum is a concept, a collective that does not hold a single shape but a murmuring congregation of tide-bound listeners who were already gathered in the dim first chamber before anything had a name. Its members remember the moment the layers of the world were folded over one another, and they still shift the sediment of old oceans whenever a forgotten rule is broken. They have never acted alone, only together.

rites.name: Nillium
rites.text: Nillium is the concept of the Three Futures in Menteores, the quiet principle by which an ending branches into alternatives. In the Era of E7 it is said to hold the Library's shelves, where every unchosen outcome waits to be read.
